name: The singular value decomposition
text: An $m\times n$ matrix $A$ may be written as $A=U\Sigma V^T$ where $U$ is an orthogonal $m\times m$ matrix, $V$ is an orthogonal $n\times n$ matrix, and $\Sigma$ is an $m\times n$ matrix whose entries are zero except for the singular values of $A$ which appear in decreasing order on the diagonal.
